title: Copilot Cloud Agent for Linear Generally Available
description: GitHub Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available. Teams can assign Linear issues directly to Copilot, automate task creation including draft PRs, progress updates, and review requests. Copilot can explore code, make changes, run automated tests and linters, and handle lightweight tasks from backlog like bug fixes and refactors.

title: Cursor Router - Intelligent Model Routing
description: Cursor Router is an intelligent model router that analyzes each request and sends it to the right model for the job. It offers three optimization modes: Intelligence (frontier quality), Balance (strong quality for daily use), and Cost (highest intelligence with optimized token spend). Available across desktop, web, iOS, CLI, and SDK.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor announced Cursor Router, a new model router that allows users to access 'frontier performance at 60% lower cost'
Cursor declared the git.exe flaw 'out of scope' for its bug bounty program

title: Smarter Linear Thread Handling
description: Replies in different Linear comment threads are now routed to the correct Devin session with improved handling of follow-up work on related tasks. Users can view PR diffs, run analysis, and use the Devin Review chat agent to propose and apply code changes.

community_feedback.quote: Where did Devin go, and what does it say about the future of AI dev tools? Devin didn't fail because the ambition was wrong. It failed because it aimed a...

title: Experimental Paginated Thread History (v0.145.0)
description: Added experimental paginated thread history with efficient resume and search capabilities. Features include persisted names, sub-agent support, and memories functionality. Improved remote onboarding, composer guidance, iPad navigation, tool activity styling, progress indicators, and Face ID behavior.

title: Artifacts call MCP connectors & Screen reader mode (v2.1.207–v2.1.212)
description: Published artifacts can pull live data and take actions through each viewer's own MCP connectors. Added public sharing links, editor roles on Team/Enterprise, and artifacts from Claude Tag sessions. Also introduced screen reader mode for accessibility, /fork command for parallel conversations, and auto mode now available on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry without opt-in.

title: Improvements to Cursor in Slack
description: Cursor in Slack now shares a plan before starting tasks, runs in multi-repo environments, and can work across channels and threads. It can extract context from workspace locations and publish updates back to original discussion threads. Refined response appearance in Slack with compact footer links and cleaner rendering of tables, PRs, and artifacts.

title: Cursor Mobile App for iOS (Public Beta)
description: Cursor for iOS is now available in public beta on all paid plans, allowing users to launch and manage always-on agents from anywhere. Features include cloud agents, remote control to direct agents from phone, live activities and push notifications, and ability to review demos, screenshots, logs, and diffs remotely.

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — June update
description: June 2026 update focused on visibility and trust with a clearer view of GitHub Copilot usage and a new trust layer for MCP (Model Context Protocol). GitHub Copilot now powers commit authoring and merge conflict resolution.

community_feedback.quote: Github copilot being bugged garbage is specific for Visual Studio. VS 2026 has been rough with Copilot from what I've heard

title: In-app browser on Desktop (v2.1.202–v2.1.206)
description: Claude Code on desktop gets a built-in browser, allowing Claude to pull up docs, designs, or any other site and interact with pages the same way it does with local dev server previews. Also added /doctor command for full setup checkup, auto mode safety improvements, and enhanced agent view rows.

community_feedback.quote: A thing I really like with Claude Code is how well it uses the bash scripts you give it. I also have a browser control MCP installed and it's pretty good.

title: Side Chats and Conversation Search (v3.11)
description: New side chats feature for parallel conversations without interrupting main agent chat, plus conversation search functionality to find past agent chats faster with local search index scaling to thousands of conversations.

community_feedback.quote: Each side chat is a durable agent conversation you can @-mention to bring context back into the main thread.

title: Redesigned Account Switcher
description: A redesigned account switcher makes it easier to move between organizations with a clearer two-pane layout. Improved bulk secret import with name validation and per-line error reporting.

title: Tool Registry Discovery (v0.50.0)
description: Introduced tool registry discovery capabilities to automatically detect and register available tools. Enhanced release verification by ignoring scripts during verification and preventing workspace binary shadowing.
